questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, ?
questions.e: Each term is 4 more than the previous one (common difference 4), so the next term is 19 + 4 = 23.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 2, 6, 18, 54, ?
questions.e: Each term is 3 times the previous one, so the next term is 54 × 3 = 162.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
questions.e: The terms are the squares 1², 2², 3², 4², 5², so the next is 6² = 36.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: A, C, E, G, I, ?
questions.e: Each letter is two places after the previous one (A+2 = C, C+2 = E, ...). I + 2 = K.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 100, 93, 86, 79, ?
questions.e: Each term is 7 less than the previous one, so the next is 79 − 7 = 72.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, ?
questions.e: The series lists the prime numbers in order. The prime after 13 is 17; 15 and 16 are composite.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: Z, X, V, T, R, ?
questions.e: Each letter is two places before the previous one, moving backwards: R − 2 = P.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 5, 6, 8, 11, 15, 20, ?
questions.e: The differences are +1, +2, +3, +4, +5, so the next is +6. 20 + 6 = 26.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, ?
questions.e: Each term is the previous one multiplied by 2, 3, 4, 5, then 6 (factorials). 120 × 6 = 720.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 4, 9, 19, 39, 79, ?
questions.e: Each term is 2 × previous + 1: 4→9→19→39→79. So the next is 79 × 2 + 1 = 159.

questions.q: Find the next pair: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.e: The first letter moves forward (A, B, C, D, E) while the second moves backward (Z, Y, X, W, V). The next pair is EV.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: B, E, I, N, T, ?
questions.e: The gaps are +3, +4, +5, +6, so the next is +7. T is the 20th letter; 20 + 7 = 27, which wraps round to A (27 − 26 = 1).

questions.q: Find the missing term: 3, 8, 15, 24, ?, 48
questions.e: The terms are n² − 1 for n = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, 48. The missing term is 6² − 1 = 35.

questions.q: Find the wrong term in the series: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, 36, 50
questions.e: The terms follow n² + 1: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, 37, 50. The sixth term should be 37, not 36.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 5, 10, 8, 16, 14, 28, 26, ?
questions.e: The operations alternate: ×2, −2, ×2, −2, ×2, −2. So the next term is 26 × 2 = 52.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 3, 5, 6, 10, 12, 20, 24, ?
questions.e: Two series alternate. Terms 1, 3, 5, 7 are 3, 6, 12, 24 (×2) and terms 2, 4, 6, 8 are 5, 10, 20, 40 (×2). The eighth term is 20 × 2 = 40.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 6, 11, 21, 36, 56, 81, ?
questions.e: The differences are 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, so the next difference is 30. 81 + 30 = 111.

questions.q: Find the next term in the series: 2, 9, 28, 65, 126, ?
Find the wrong pair in the series: BD, EG, HJ, KM, NQ, QS
questions.e: The first letter rises by 3 each time (B, E, H, K, N, Q) and the second letter is always two after the first. So NQ should be NP.

questions.q: Find the wrong term in the series: 4, 6, 12, 14, 28, 30, 62
questions.e: The operations alternate: +2, ×2, +2, ×2, +2, ×2. This gives 4, 6, 12, 14, 28, 30, 60, so the last term should be 60, not 62.
